about: What a better label engine means. The self-improvement loop reads this file, checks its sha256 at start and end, and may never change it.
metric_about: macro-F1 over the true/false classes, per fold of eda/splits.csv fold_group (5 folds, holdout pages excluded)
start_from: L6_judge (eda/07_improve.py): staircase timeline + page trust + failure statuses + hard rules + evidence-sum calibrator

accept_change.rule: a one-variable change is kept only if ALL hold against the current base: mean per-fold metric gain >= min_gain, better on >= folds_better of the 5 folds, pooled ECE not worse by more than ece_worse_max, and the runtime gate holds

runtime_gate.about: measured on 2 threads (the arena has 2 CPUs); retrain = every model fit of one fold (final + inner out-of-fold fits), predict extrapolated to 20,000 rows

lockbox.rule: scored once, at the very end, for the final configuration only; never used to accept or reject a change

multiple_testing: the report states the number of trials and the expected best gain of pure noise (standard error of a trial's mean gain x sqrt(2 ln n)); a final gain below it is reported as not distinguishable from noise
